title: Quality control of glycogen through direct ubiquitylation by RNF213
title_zh: RNF213通过直接泛素化实现糖原质量控制
abstract: Abstract Quality control of biomolecules is vital for organismal health. Although DNA repair and protein quality control are well understood, how cells monitor other important biomolecules such as glycogen remains ill defined. Accumulation of aberrant, poorly branched glycogen into insoluble polyglucosan bodies causes severe disease 1,2 . Here we identify autophagy of ubiquitylated aberrant glycogen as a quality control mechanism safeguarding the brain from polyglucosan buildup. This mechanism depends on the E3 ubiquitin ligase RNF213. Mice lacking ligase activity in RNF213 accumulate polyglucosan in the cerebellum, pons and hippocampus. Using cells engineered to produce polyglucosan, we show that RNF213 selectively ubiquitylates abnormal glycogen. Cryo-electron microscopy analysis of RNF213 bound to glycogen-derived maltoheptaose showed that its CBM20 domain binds linear oligosaccharides. Disruption of carbohydrate binding results in gain of E3 ligase activity towards physiological glycogen, indicating that the CBM20 domain limits RNF213 activity towards physiological glycogen. Epistasis analysis places RNF213 upstream of LUBAC, suggesting a hierarchical network of multiple E3 ligases surveying glycogen quality. Ubiquitylated polyglucosan recruits autophagy receptors SQSTM1, TAX1BP1 and optineurin, thereby triggering uptake into autophagosomes. These findings identify RNF213 as a quality control factor preventing polyglucosan accumulation in astrocytes through direct ubiquitylation of polyglucosan, demonstrating an essential role for non-protein ubiquitylation in glycogen quality control.
abstract_zh: 摘要 细胞内生物分子的质量控制对机体健康至关重要。虽然DNA修复和蛋白质质量控制已被充分理解，但细胞如何监测其他重要生物分子，如糖原，仍不明确。异常、分支不良的糖原积聚成不可溶的多葡萄糖体导致严重疾病1,2。本文发现，泛素化的异常糖原的自噬是保护大脑免受多葡萄糖体堆积的质量控制机制。该机制依赖于E3泛素连接酶RNF213。缺乏RNF213酶活性的老鼠在小脑、脑桥和海马中积聚多葡萄糖体。利用工程细胞产生多葡萄糖体，我们证明RNF213可选择性地泛素化异常糖原。对RNF213与糖原衍生的马洛七糖结合的冷冻电镜分析显示，其CBM20结构域结合线性寡糖。破坏碳水化合物结合导致对生理糖原的E3连接酶活性增强，表明CBM20结构域限制RNF213对生理糖原的活性。遗传互作分析将RNF213置于LUBAC之上，提示存在多种E3连接酶监测糖原质量的层级网络。泛素化的多葡萄糖体招募自噬受体SQSTM1、TAX1BP1和optineurin，从而触发其进入自噬体。研究结果将RNF213确定为通过直接泛素化多葡萄糖体来防止星形胶质细胞中多葡萄糖体积聚的质量控制因子，证明非蛋白泛素化在糖原质量控制中的重要作用。
